verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS incident-management platform, so the axis applies. The pack contains no documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out. The tenant-level AI enablement control (firehydrant-docs-14) is an adjacent feature-availability switch, not a telemetry opt-out, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
